reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance deterministically ranks only the normalized needs it receives and preserves the two handoff record IDs/source IDs in the assigned output.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: strict market-demand evidence is not independently established by provenance formatting

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand hard-codes fallback record IDs n06-r07 and n06-r08 and selects them despite lower demand scores, while excluding higher-scored needs in the same assigned input. That behavior makes the result depend on fixture IDs rather than observed market-demand support, so the selected demand cannot be trusted under the strict criteria.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes must support demand claims
generic keyword matches and unrelated candidates are issues
missing or contradictory evidence must remain visible

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence performs bounded normalization of the selected records without changing the handoff identities. It does not establish demand validity itself, but the visible output matches its declared role.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: background or normalized records cannot by themselves establish customer demand
